versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Headless Trading skill – an autonomous trading toolkit for AI agents on Solana and BNB Chain.

- Enables browserless token swaps on Raydium (Solana) and PancakeSwap (BNB Chain).
- Fetches real-time prices, checks balances, and monitors liquidity pools.
- Supports portfolio management and automated trading strategies (limit orders, DCA, stop-loss, arbitrage).
- Includes code examples and workflow guidance for common trading operations.
- Provides security best practices and troubleshooting tips for safe and reliable usage.
